evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Parallel syntactic frame ('A rollback [we have not X] is a rollback [we do not Y]') constructing an antithetical equivalence between unrehearsed capability and non-existence.

mints.name: RuleAsMatchedOpposition
mints.title: crystallize a rule into matched opposed clauses
mints.frame: Does this statement construct an operational principle through symmetrical, matched antithetical clauses?
